[EN] It's all pretty unbelievable, isn't it? Intelligent orcans. Orcans who want to be our allies. Nobody's going to believe this back in Velika, that's for sure.
[ES] Todo es bastante increíble, ¿verdad? Orcans inteligentes. Orcans que quieren ser nuestros aliados. Nadie va a creer esto de regreso en Velika, eso seguro.
